about_short_description.short_description: Creative Market is a marketplace for ready-to-use design assets from independent creators around the world.

product.name: Creative Asset Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for purchasing downloadable design assets, including fonts, templates, graphics, photos, illustrations, icons, mockups, brushes, effects, and 3D resources.

product.name: Creative Market Membership
product.description: A subscription program providing monthly credits, discounts on marketplace assets, and access to a curated monthly collection of premium design resources.

product.name: Enterprise Creative Asset Sales
product.description: A business purchasing service for obtaining creative assets and typography with commercial licensing, purchasing support, and licensing options for larger teams and organizations.

product.name: Font Marketplace and Licensing
product.description: A catalog of commercially licensable typefaces from independent foundries and designers, supporting desktop, web, mobile application, OEM, and perpetual-use scenarios.

product.name: Creator Shop Platform
product.description: A self-service platform that enables independent designers to sell digital assets, set prices, manage products, communicate with customers, and receive earnings.

product.name: Free Design Asset Downloads
product.description: A free-access program offering selected design assets each week and a larger curated monthly collection for members.
